title: Design System: Dra. Sandra Ardila — Ejercicios de Masticación y Deglución

display.purpose: Hero headlines only; the emphasized clause is set in italic with the text-gradient.

heading.purpose: Section titles, card titles, nav-level headings — same family as body, different weight.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, table content, form labels, everyday UI text.

shadows.name: glass-panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Sticky nav glass panel only — the system's one shadow, never used for card/dropdown elevation.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default entrance easing for hero/landing motion (Framer Motion).

motion.name: depth-field-drift
motion.value: per-blob autonomous bobble + cursor parallax + scroll drift, all frozen under prefers-reduced-motion

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's single highest-emphasis action — flat brand-purple fill (no gradient), reserved for one per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5b3c8e; color: #ffffff; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.9rem; border: none; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4c3486; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(195,40,125,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Everyday secondary action — does most of the interface's work so the primary fill stays rare.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #2e2440; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.9rem; border: 1px solid #e4dcf2; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f1e9f9; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #c3287d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(195,40,125,0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat, ring-bordered container — depth comes from the border, never a shadow. Opaque so it stays readable over the depth field.
components.html:
Cumplimiento semanal
82% de los momentos prescritos registrados esta semana.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 1.26rem; box-shadow: none; outline: 1px solid rgba(46,36,64,0.1); padding: 1rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; color: #2e2440; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6f6389; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Transparent, ring-bordered field sharing the same focus language as buttons.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2rem; width: 100%; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #e4dcf2; border-radius: 0.9rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; color: #2e2440; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6f6389; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #c3287d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(195,40,125,0.5); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Fully-rounded status/label chip used for compliance state and 'new patient' markers.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #5b3c8e; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Sticky Nav (Glass Panel)
components.description: The system's one glass/shadow moment — translucent blurred bar carrying the brand mark (no tagline) and 1-2 flat/outline actions, never gradient.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%); border-bottom: 1px solid #e4dcf2; box-shadow: 0 20px 45px -20px rgba(91,60,142,0.35); } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #3c2a72; } .ds-nav-brand-accent { color: #c3287d; }

components.name: Depth Field Blob
components.description: One layer of the root-mounted interactive 3D background — a soft, semi-transparent, distorted sphere. Not a real DOM component (WebGL/react-three-fiber), approximated here as a radial-gradient blob for the panel's preview surface.
components.css: .ds-blob { width: 140px; height: 140px; border-radius: 46% 54% 61% 39% / 45% 41% 59% 55%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, rgba(185,174,232,0.55), rgba(91,60,142,0.35) 70%); filter: blur(0.5px); opacity: 0.6; }

narrative.overview: A clinical adherence tool that earns trust two ways at once: precise, uncluttered structure for the daily work of logging and reviewing an exercise, set against a living, interactive background of soft, organic, glass-like blobs drifting in brand purple/magenta/gold/periwinkle. The field is never a decoration parked in one corner — it spans the full viewport on every page, shifts with cursor and scroll, and reads as one continuous atmosphere rather than a UI widget. It is expressive (hero variant) on the landing page and deliberately subdued (ambient variant) everywhere data and forms need to lead. Working surfaces (cards, tables, forms) stay flat, ring-bordered, and fast to scan; the field supplies the warmth and motion so the UI chrome doesn't have to. Typography moved to a confident editorial pairing — Instrument Serif for display headlines, Inter for everything else — replacing the earlier Fraunces/Sora/Nunito trio.
keyCharacteristics: The depth field is a background, not an ornament: full-bleed, interactive (pointer parallax + scroll drift), mounted once at the root and never duplicated per page.
Blobs are soft and organic (distorted, smooth-shaded spheres), not hard-faceted geometry — abstract atmosphere, not solid objects.
A perspective-correct empty column runs down the center of the viewport at every depth, so blobs never drift behind the centered reading column.
Two intensities only — hero (landing) and ambient (everywhere else) — no per-page bespoke tuning.
The brand gradient (.text-gradient) is reserved for exactly one emphasized headline clause; primary buttons use a flat brand-purple fill instead of a gradient.
All iconography is lucide-react line icons at a consistent stroke weight — no emoji anywhere in the product.

rules.name: The Rare Gradient Rule
rules.body: .text-gradient (purple→magenta) appears on at most one emphasized clause per screen — typically the hero headline's italic phrase. Buttons and other UI use a flat brand-purple fill instead of the gradient.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Exactly one interactive background — the depth field — exists across the whole app, mounted once at the root layout. No page mounts its own decorative background, blob, or secondary 3D element.

rules.name: The Clear Column Rule
rules.body: Blobs are excluded from a center column at every depth, sized as a fraction of that depth's own on-screen half-width (perspective-correct, not a flat world-space offset), so near and far blobs are equally kept clear of the centered reading column.

rules.name: The One-Phrase Italic Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif italic is reserved for a single emphasized clause per headline. It never sets a full sentence or paragraph.

rules.name: The One-Grotesk Rule
rules.body: Every non-display role (heading, body, label) renders the same family (Inter) at different weights. Don't introduce a second sans-serif for any UI role.

rules.name: The Ring-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Structural surfaces (cards, inputs, tables) gain edges from a 1px ring/border, never a drop shadow. Reserve shadow for the one glass-panel moment.

dos: Do keep the depth field to exactly two variants (hero, ambient) chosen by route — never hand-tune a third intensity for a specific page.
Do compute any blob-placement exclusion zone as a fraction of that blob's own on-screen size at its depth, never as a flat world-space offset.
Do avoid shard/blob colors close in luminance to --ink (e.g. brand-purple-dark) — a background element close to the text color's own darkness can wash text out.
Do reserve .text-gradient for one emphasized headline clause per screen; use flat brand-purple for every button, including primary CTAs.
Do keep page-root wrappers background-transparent so the depth field shows through; only --card and other explicit surfaces should be opaque.
Do use lucide-react for every icon need — never emoji, never a mix of icon systems on the same screen.
Do derive every corner radius from the single --radius root token rather than hardcoding a new pixel value.
Do build structural depth from a 1px ring/border and background contrast, never a drop shadow, outside the sticky nav.
donts: Don't mount a per-page decorative background (blob, gradient, secondary 3D element) — the depth field is the only atmosphere layer.
Don't apply the brand gradient to a button fill; it's a headline-only treatment now.
Don't add a general shadow scale for card/dropdown elevation — that's a departure from the Ring-Not-Shadow Rule.
Don't introduce a second sans-serif for any heading/body/label role, or a second italic-emphasis pattern beyond the hero headline.
Don't fabricate testimonials, patient counts, clinical outcome claims, or specialty taglines on sales-facing surfaces — no real evidence exists yet.
